notes.title: 🐾Demo Update + Festival News! 🐾
notes.content:
Hello pupventurers!

We’re excited to share some big news about Donna: The Canine Quest!

✨ Demo Update
The demo has been updated with polish and improvements to make your adventure smoother and even more fun. Whether it’s slaying pesky imps, gearing up with new armor, or exploring Barkhaven, things feel sharper than before. Your feedback has been great, and we’re working hard to keep refining Donna’s journey!

⚠️ Important Note
If you played the first version of the demo, we highly recommend starting a new game to avoid possible bugs or progression issues.

🎉 Festival Participation
We’re thrilled to announce that Donna: The Canine Quest is part of the No Time to Loot Festival! This is a fantastic chance for new players to discover Donna’s world.

💌 Wishlist & Support
Every wishlist truly helps us on this journey. If you haven’t yet, please consider adding Donna: The Canine Quest to your Steam wishlist and sharing it with your friends.

Thank you for playing and for joining us on this adventure. Donna still has many quests ahead, and we can’t wait to show you more!

– Raze Games

👉No Time To Loot Festival

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

indie.io's Steam Publisher Page

Raze Games is super happy to be working with indie.io as it will allow our small team to focus on what we do best - making our best games!

We’re thrilled to announce that indie.io is the publisher of our games (and we’re honored they chose us too – thank you, indie.io!). There are several reasons why we partnered with them:

 We deeply admire indie.io’s diverse portfolio of indie games, which features a fantastic mix of casual and serious titles spanning genres like fantasy, action, rpg, and more. We believe Donna: The Canine Quest will be a great addition to their lineup and hope to connect with gamers who love these styles!
 indie.io gives us the creative freedom to bring our vision to life and create the games we’re passionate about. They don’t dictate what we should make; instead, they support us in making our games the best they can be and ensuring they reach a wider audience.
 Here’s a fun fact: indie.io also operates Wiki.GG, an amazing platform for game wikis! We’re excited to partner with Wiki.GG to bring you the Donna: The Canine Quest Wiki. If you enjoy exploring game lore and details, check out Wiki.GG—it might even have a page for your favorite game!

Check out Wiki.GG!

Looking ahead, we’re thrilled to partner with indie.io to bring Donna: The Canine Quest to you, the players! This collaboration is an incredible milestone for our small studio, Raze Games. Working with such an amazing publisher will help us grow as developers and deliver authentic, unforgettable gaming experiences.

Don’t forget to wishlist Donna: The Canine Quest! Follow us on social media to stay updated on future announcements.

Thanks for your support, and a big shoutout to our friends at indie.io for joining us on this exciting journey!

Happy gaming,
Raze Games
